reasons: Section (h) expressly permits either Party — including AP (our client) — to assign without consent to an affiliate, a purchaser of all or substantially all relevant assets, or a successor by merger, stock sale or consolidation, satisfying the preferred M&A/affiliate carve-out.
All other assignments require consent that 'shall not be unreasonably withheld', matching the preferred consent standard, and the restriction is symmetric, so it also clears the fallback.

No change-of-control trigger or Vendor termination/re-pricing right on Customer change of control appears in the cited clause or elsewhere per the finding's search, so walk-away territory is not implicated.

Absent preferred sub-elements (no express bar on Kubient assigning to an AP competitor; Kubient sharing the consent-free carve-out) are minor and correctly noted in the rationale rather than redlined.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the paragraph is unchanged; the deterministic check confirms the successor/affiliate carve-out is present.
